title: Matemágico · Foc Binari and Ánima
description: Matemágico, Gerard's ánima of the mind (docs/animas/matemagico/): its blueprint interface (navy graph paper, gold sums, index-card commands, a number line on the card), the Ánima circles that replace Secundaria (five to start; a skill spends its cost, Defender gives two back), and its first spell, Foc Binari: the hand goes up, two braided streams of fire fly to one foe, and a 1 sets it on fire (Quemadura) while a 0 fizzles. At 35 the same ánima thinks out loud over his head in fights.

steps.caption: Matemágico's interface: index-card commands, no watermark behind the fight, five Ánima circles under Gerard's PV
Habilidad: Foc Binari, costing one circle
Its details: light fire damage to one foe, may burn, melts the gum

steps.eval: { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = .12; const random = Math.random; Math.random = () => .9; try { document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-side="foes"]:not(:disabled)').click(); } finally { Math.random = random; } }

steps.caption: Slowed down: Gerard raises his hand
Two braided streams of fire, gold and white-hot, fly to the dog
They land: a 1, so it catches (Quemadura), and one circle of Ánima is spent
The dog burns: its Quemadura chip counts the rounds left
Round 2: four circles left, the dog still burning
Defender gives Ánima back: the circle fills again with a glow
The status screen at 35 with Matemágico on: the same blueprint, Ánima circles and Foc Binari's cost
At 35, in a fight, Matemágico thinks out loud: birds of light and thoughts over his head
